//: Canonical stylelint config for all five Chance Theater submodules. DO NOT EDIT THE RENDERED .stylelintrc.json IN A SUBMODULE — edit this file and run .build/sh/audit.sh sync.
//1: @wordpress/stylelint-config is 'per the WordPress CSS Coding Standards' per the @wordpress/scripts docs (GLOBAL_REVIEW.md §1c) — unlike the ESLint substitution, this one IS handbook-cited, just not from the CSS handbook page itself.
//2: customSyntax is load-bearing, not cosmetic: without it stylelint parses .scss as plain CSS and chokes on @use/nesting/interpolation, producing CssSyntaxError noise instead of real lint findings (found 2026-08-30 when theatrum-credits' first real run reported 3 fake syntax errors alongside 3 genuine style findings).
//3: Two rule overrides below (2026-09-02). Both are tool gaps, not deviations from the CSS standard: postcss-scss parses SCSS at-rules but at-rule-no-unknown has no SCSS vocabulary, and @wordpress/stylelint-config's kebab-only class pattern rejects the BEM class names @wordpress/components itself ships (.components-tab-panel__tabs), which stylesheets must target verbatim.

selector-class-pattern.message: Selector should be lowercase, hyphen-separated, optionally with BEM __element / --modifier (selector-class-pattern)
